newsitem.title: USA: Lason, other stocks recommended - NY Times.
newsitem.headline: Lason, other stocks recommended - NY Times.

text.p: Shares of Lason Holdings Inc and other stocks are recommended by analysts, the New York Times reported in its latest edition.

Lason, which provides services to help companies manage their paperwork, has made 15 acquisitions in the last two and a half years, boosting annual revenue to $70 million in 1996 from $46 million in 1995, the paper said.
It quoted Robert Gardiner, manager of the Wasatch Micro-Cap fund, as saying the acquisitions should continue, adding at least $25 million a year in revenue going forward.
The company's shares closed up 5/8 Thursday at 27-1/8.
Cable Design Technologies Corp also has room for acquisitions because its industry -- cable manufacturing -- is highly fragmented, said Brian Cressey, a principal at Golder, Thoma.
Cressey said he expects Cable Design to make four acquisitions in the next 12 months that will boost annual revenues by $100 million.
Analysts also like shares of American Medserve Corp and CoreStaff Inc, the paper said.
